title: ticket_reproduction_input/v1
description: The step input that the host writes to .baltor/step/input.json before launch. Every path is relative to the workspace root, which is the top folder of the git worktree. The step reads this file and never edits it; every evidence file records its sha256.

test_file.description: The file that receives the new test. It must lie under one of test_path_prefixes.

test_name.description: The exact name of the new test function or method.

behavior.description: The expected and the observed behavior, in one or two sentences taken from the ticket.

test_path_prefixes.description: A prefix that ends with a slash covers a folder; any other prefix names one file.

test_command.description: The program and its arguments, run without a shell from the workspace root. It runs only the new test.

host_placed_paths.description: Files or folders the host wrote into the workspace for this step. The change check ignores them.

evidence_dir.description: Where the recorder writes one evidence file per run, for example .baltor/step-output/evidence.

output_path.description: A path inside .baltor/ and outside .baltor/step/, the packet folder that the step only reads.
